findings.evidence: Basic.lean:134 `noncomputable def ofGeometricallyIntegral (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G] [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] : AbelianVariety K where` — same four fields, all `inferInstance`; Trivial.lean:55-66 restates them. Basic.lean:134 currently carries no `@[expose]`, so the reported restoration is not present at head.
findings.fix: Define `trivial K := ofGeometricallyIntegral (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K))))`, discharging the two side conditions as `haveI`s via `Over.tensorUnit_hom` before the term (as the author's own reply for `739e321` describes), and add `@[expose]` to `ofGeometricallyIntegral` in Basic.lean so `trivial_toOver`, `toTrivial` and `eq_toTrivial` still reduce.
findings.issue: `trivial` is built as a raw four-field `AbelianVariety` structure literal (`toOver`/`grpObj`/`isProper`/`geometricallyIntegral`), duplicating the existing constructor `AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral` (Basic.lean:134-139), whose body is exactly `toOver := G; grpObj := inferInstance; isProper := inferInstance; geometricallyIntegral := inferInstance`. This also bypasses the constructor's `@[simp]` API (`ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver/_one/_mul/_inv`, Basic.lean:141-175), so none of it fires on `trivial`.

summary: The geometric-integrality instance is genuinely absent from Mathlib and the terminality API is new. But `trivial` re-derives the existing `ofGeometricallyIntegral` constructor by hand — the author's reply claims this was restored in `739e321`, and the head commit does not contain it.
